name: Brilon (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of white with three black stripes in the lower part, charged at the top with the city arms of Brilon (a black key and a cross on white).
history: Municipal flag of Brilon; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
